description: List asset statuses for the organization. These define the lifecycle states an asset or infrastructure feature can be in. Each has a `module`: facilities (assets), infrastructure (features), or null (shared by both); pick one matching the record, or a shared one. The status with system_key archived is the built-in Archived status: assigning it to an asset archives the asset.

module.description: Only records in this workspace; none = shared ones only

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.

name: list_asset_statuses
title: List asset statuses
